name: silage-bag
draw: Long tube shaped bag lying on the ground with ribbed sides and a tied off end.

name: grain-probe
draw: Long hollow spear with slotted openings pushed diagonally into a pile of grain.

name: grain-pile
draw: Conical heap of grain kernels on a floor with a few kernels scattered around its base.

draw: Grain spread in a flat layer on a mat with a wooden rake resting on it and the sun above.

name: solar-dryer
draw: Box on legs with a sloped glass top and slatted trays of sliced produce inside under the sun.

name: rice-drying-rack
draw: Horizontal poles on posts with bundles of harvested rice hung over them in a row.

name: hay-drying-rack
draw: Wooden fence like rack with hay draped thickly over its horizontal rails.

name: tobacco-curing-barn
draw: Tall barn with a ventilated roof ridge and an open side showing bunches of large leaves hanging on sticks.

name: coffee-drying-bed
draw: Raised table with a mesh top covered in a layer of small round coffee cherries.

name: cotton-module
draw: Large round bale of cotton wrapped in plastic sheeting sitting in a harvested field.

draw: Warning triangle with a person sinking up to the chest in a heap of grain.

draw: Tractor tipped on its side on a slope with a roll bar frame over the seat.

draw: Box shaped machine with a hand crank, raw cotton feeding in at the top and a toothed roller visible.

draw: Pair of upright rollers on a frame with a crank handle, cane stalks feeding between them and juice dripping into a pan.

name: jab-planter

draw: Rear of a tractor with two lower lift arms and one upper link arm arranged in a triangle.

name: pto-shaft
draw: Telescoping drive shaft with a ribbed safety guard and a universal joint at each end.

name: molded-fruit-tray
draw: Molded pulp tray with rows of round cups, several holding apples.

draw: Large wooden bin on skids heaped with apples, with forklift slots at the base.

draw: Wooden barrel with hoops, heaped with apples above the rim.

draw: Shallow tray holding a grid of small square berry baskets, each filled with berries.

draw: Open cardboard box with leafy greens, a carrot and a leek sticking out above the flaps.

draw: Inclined wooden trough with square paddles on a looped chain, turned by a crank wheel at the top, lifting water.

draw: Person holding a bunch of cut grain stalks in one hand and a curved sickle in the other.

draw: Person bent over in a flooded paddy pushing seedlings into the water, a bundle of seedlings in the other hand.

name: cotton-picking
draw: Person bent over a cotton shrub picking bolls into a long sack slung from the shoulder and trailing behind.

name: tea-plucking
draw: Person with a basket on the back plucking leaves from the flat top of a waist high tea bush.

draw: Wall calendar page with a seedling in one cell and a few other days marked.

draw: Crop rows on the left, a curved arrow, and a plate with a fork on the right.

draw: Canvas bag worn on the chest with crossed shoulder straps, apples filling it.

draw: Two curved wheat stalks forming an open wreath with ears meeting near the top.
